english.title: Personal licence holder charged with an offence fail to notify court of notifiable event - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been charged with a relevant offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..), and being the holder of a personal licence which you had produced to **(..SPECIFY THE MAGISTRATES' COURT..) failed, without reasonable excuse, to notify the court at your next appearance in connection with that offence, of a notifiable event that occurred before you were

(A)_[convicted of and sentenced for]_
(B)_[acquitted of]_

that offence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 128(4), (6) and (7) of the Licensing Act 2003.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes: Section 128(5) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides the circumstances which comprise a "notifiable event".
